title: Reflection Coefficient
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the reflection coefficient R using Fresnel's formula for normal incidence.

title: Transmission Coefficient
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the transmission coefficient T using Fresnel's formula for normal incidence.

title: Momentum Transfer
description: Important Criteria: The student must explain the concept of momentum transfer in relation to light pressure and how it relates to the incident flux.

title: Final Pressure Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the light pressure p using the derived coefficients and the incident flux.

title: Sum of Coefficients
description: Important Criteria: The student must verify that R + T = 1 as a consistency check.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign mistakes in the momentum transfer calculation.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should not omit any necessary factors in the pressure calculation.
